questions.question: Which country is the only one in South America that has coastlines on both the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea?
questions.fun_fact: Colombia's strategic geographical position makes it a biological hotspot as the gateway to South America.

questions.question: What is the atomic number of the chemical element carbon?
questions.fun_fact: Carbon's atomic number of 6 means every carbon atom has 6 protons in its nucleus.

questions.question: The historic Magna Carta was sealed in 1215 by King John at which English meadow?
questions.fun_fact: Runnymede is located near the River Thames in the county of Surrey, England.

questions.question: Which animated feature film won the very first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature?
questions.fun_fact: Shrek won the inaugural Best Animated Feature Oscar at the 74th Academy Awards in 2002.

questions.question: Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese originates from which region of Italy?
questions.fun_fact: Authentic Parmigiano-Reggiano can only be produced in specific provinces within Emilia-Romagna and Mantua.

questions.question: What is the gestation period of an African elephant, the longest of any land mammal?
questions.fun_fact: Because of this extraordinarily long gestation period of roughly 22 months, elephant populations take a long time to recover.

questions.question: In American football, how many players are on the field for a single team during standard play?
questions.fun_fact: Each team fields 11 players, meaning there are 22 total players on the gridiron at any given time.

questions.question: What term describes words that are spelled and pronounced identically but have completely different meanings based on context?
questions.fun_fact: While homonyms share both spelling and pronunciation, homographs share spelling only, and homophones share sound only.

questions.question: Which spacecraft holds the record for being the farthest human-made object from Earth?
questions.fun_fact: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 has traveled beyond the heliopause and entered interstellar space.

questions.question: The island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean is shared by which two sovereign nations?
questions.fun_fact: Hispaniola is the second-largest island in the Antilles and one of the most politically divided islands in the world.
